chunks: Muhammad bin Yahya, from Ali bin Al Hassan Al Taymi, from Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Zurara, from Muhammad bin Al Fuzayl, from Abu Hamza, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
'Allah fends off the destruction from the whole town due to the (existence of just) one Momin.'

key_terms.الْفَنَاءَ: destruction / annihilation — total ruination or perishing that is averted through Allah's mercy
key_terms.الْقَرْيَةِ: the town / village — the settlement or community that benefits from the believer's presence
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِ: the believer (mu'min) — the person of sincere and complete iman (faith)
key_terms.الْوَاحِدِ: the single one — stressing that even one believer alone is sufficient to draw down divine protection
key_terms.لَيَدْفَعُ: fends off / actively wards away — Allah's volitional repulsion of harm and destruction from a community

ai.seo_question: Does the presence of a single believer protect an entire town from destruction according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated from Imam Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), declares that Allah fends off total destruction and annihilation from an entire town by virtue of the presence of even a single believer (mu'min). It affirms the immense spiritual worth of sincere faith and establishes the true believer as a locus of divine mercy and protection for the community at large. This teaching reflects the Shia theological understanding that the faithful individual serves as a conduit of Allah's rahmah toward those around them.
